assets.description: Primary baseline station powerhouse generator with block pre-heaters and automated katabatic fuel scrubbers.
assets.notes: Base power unit for Bharati Station. Serviced every 500 running hours.

assets.description: Sled-mounted diesel generator equipped with insulated canopy for temporary scientific drill traverses.
assets.notes: Minor exhaust heat-shield rattle observed during last field run.

assets.description: Emergency backup electrical source for medical ward and comms room cold starts.
assets.notes: Tested monthly under simulated blackout test protocols.

assets.description: Heavy tracked transport snow vehicle for freight sled towing, crevasse safety, and airstrip compaction.
assets.notes: Tracks tensioned and hydraulic fluid sampled for winter protocol.

assets.description: High-flotation utility snowmobile for fast scientist transport and crevasse rescue patrols.
assets.notes: Right ski runner replaced after crossing sastrugi ridge.

assets.description: Medium personnel carrier cab snowcat for Schirmacher Oasis research traverses.
assets.notes: Track drive sprocket teeth worn. In workshop awaiting replacement drive pins from India.

assets.asset_name: Cryo-Drill Hans Tausen Ice Core Drill System
assets.description: Deep electromechanical ice core sampling drill with glycol chip filtration and vacuum core barrels.
assets.notes: Successfully collected 120m paleoclimate ice core samples.

assets.description: High-resolution atmospheric greenhouse gas interferometer analyzing ozone depletion & stratospheric vortex dynamics.
assets.notes: Laser alignment stable; detector liquid nitrogen dewar holding nominal pressure.

assets.description: De-iced radome stabilized satellite communication link connecting Bharati to NCPOR Goa and INCOIS.
assets.notes: Signal-to-noise ratio normal; internal heating coils operating within specs.

assets.asset_name: Motorola MOTOTRBO DP4801e Polar VHF/UHF Base
assets.description: High-power encrypted expedition radio transceiver for station-to-traverse convoy safety comms.
assets.notes: Mast antenna snapped during blizzard katabatic gust (78 knots). Transceiver circuit intact but antenna feeds severed.

assets.asset_name: Trimble NetR9 Geodetic GNSS Reference Receiver
assets.description: Continuously operating Antarctic tectonic plate motion reference station with choke ring antenna.
assets.notes: Zero cycle slips; solar power buffer stable.

assets.asset_name: Zodiac Milpro Mark IV Heavy Inflatable Rescue Boat
assets.description: Armored multi-chamber inflatable workboat for sea-ice surveying and marine sampling in Prydz Bay.
assets.notes: Outboard engine winterized with arctic grease.

assets.description: Specialized deep-freeze vault for microbial cryo-preservation and Antarctic lake water core aliquots.
assets.notes: Dual cascade compressors running at -81.4°C nominal.

assets.asset_name: Tadano GR-300XL Rough Terrain Polar Crane
assets.description: Heavy hydraulic mobile crane for container offloading on fast ice and fuel bladder placement.
assets.notes: Hydraulic boom cylinder seals inspected under low-temp glycol heating.

assets.asset_name: DJI Matrice 350 RTK Arctic Drone Surveyor
assets.description: Self-heating battery drone payload carrying multispectral and thermal sensors for glacier crevasse tracking.
assets.notes: Equipped with TB65 battery warming pack for -30°C flight operations.

assignments.notes: Primary station power assignment for 44th ISEA winter season.
Deployed to Field Camp A to support glaciology core drilling operations.
Emergency comms relay post for traverse route.

transfers.from_location: Cape Town Port (Vessel MV Vasiliy Golovnin)
transfers.notes: Transported via heavy sledge from fast ice offloading zone.

transfers.reason: Scientific field operation & ice core drilling electrical supply
transfers.notes: Towed with PistenBully PB300 across 28km groomed snow track.

transfers.reason: Paleoclimate deep ice core extraction campaign
transfers.notes: Mounted on heated scientific shelter sled.

maintenance.inspection_details: Inspected fuel injectors, oil viscosity, turbocharger bearings, and block heater circuits.
maintenance.work_performed: Flushed lube oil, installed dual Racor arctic fuel filters, cleaned air intake pre-screen.
maintenance.parts_used: 2x Fuel Filter FF5776, 1x Lube Filter LF9009, 38L Valvoline Premium Blue Polar 0W-40
maintenance.notes: Generator load tested at 80% capacity for 2 hours with zero thermal anomalies.

maintenance.inspection_details: Vibration detected in exhaust support bracket; battery fluid specific gravity low.
maintenance.work_performed: Re-torqued exhaust manifold, replenished low-temp electrolyte in starter battery.
maintenance.parts_used: Exhaust clamp gasket, 2L Arctic coolant mix
maintenance.notes: Mandatory field check scheduled before next blizzard window.

maintenance.problem: Sprocket drive tooth failure and high vibration index (7.9)
maintenance.inspection_details: Right side drive sprocket exhibiting 40% shear wear from traversing frozen blue-ice moraine.
maintenance.work_performed: Disassembled track drive, removed damaged drive segments, placed unit in heated workshop bay.
maintenance.parts_used: Awaiting Drive Pin Segment Kit from India logistics resupply
maintenance.notes: Vehicle immobilised in Maitri workshop. Do not operate.

incidents.description: VHF Tactical Antenna array sheared off at base mount during Category 2 katabatic storm (gusts 78 knots).
incidents.resolution_notes: Temporary wire dipole antenna rigged for emergency reception. High-gain directional replacement antenna required.

incidents.description: Track drive sprocket teeth fractured on blue ice pressure ridge during Maitri-to-Oasis transport run.
incidents.resolution_notes: Snowcat towed back to Maitri workshop. Unit status changed to UNDER_MAINTENANCE.
